acceptance: WARN cycle that creates a ship commit consumes its items in that commit with the verdict recorded — red-first on the cycle-1494 shape.
WARN cycle with no ship commit leaves items pickable (existing test evolved, not deleted).
go vet + ship package suites + -race green.

files: go/internal/phases/ship/consume_integration_test.go (WARN fixture currently pins the OLD behavior — TestShipFromWorktree_WarnVerdictDoesNotConsume must evolve to distinguish ships-vs-doesn't)
fix: Change consumeCommittedItems' gate from (ClassCycle && acs PASS) to (ClassCycle && ship-commit-created && red_count==0), recording the verdict in the consumed annotation ({verdict: WARN}) so triage/audit history keeps the distinction. Preserve the true no-ship WARN behavior (no commit => no consumption => item stays pickable — correct). Red-first: fixture WARN-with-zero-reds shipping cycle must consume in-commit (pins the cycle-1494 shape); fixture WARN-that-does-not-ship must not consume (preserves the original design's intent).
notes: Found during batch-20260816c close-out because the old processed/ promotion log line fired where #466's in-commit consumption should have. The manual console consumption of the sleep-time item rides the same boundary landing that carries this filing. | REPRIORITIZED 2026-08-17 0.82->0.84 per docs/incidents/2026-08-17-failure-rate-review-1481-1503.md ranked plan (operator directive: prioritize pipeline/fail-rate improvements).
root_cause: #466's gate condition conflated 'verdict WARN' with 'nothing landed'. The ship-eligibility floor is red_count==0 — a WARN verdict with zero reds can ship a real commit. The consumption rule keys on the verdict when it should key on the LANDING: if the cycle pushed a commit that delivers the item's work, the item must be consumed in that commit regardless of PASS-vs-WARN.
summary: Cycle-1494 (batch-20260816c): acs verdict WARN with red_count=0; the cycle shipped 4f133efe (14 files incl. the faillearn novelty feature) and FinalVerdict PASS — but consumeCommittedItems gates on acs PASS only (by #466 design: 'WARN ships stay pickable'), so the tracked item 2026-07-05T15-20-00Z-sleep-time-kb-consolidation.json stayed on main while the plane-local promotion moved its runtime copy to gitignored processed/. Every fresh worktree now offers an item whose deliverable is already landed — the exact re-pick burn #466 closed for the PASS quadrant. Console-consumed manually at this boundary; the class needs the decision.
title: A WARN-verdict cycle that nonetheless SHIPS leaves its inbox item unconsumed on main — landed work stays pickable (the #466 PASS-only gate's uncovered quadrant)
